K11272.title: From someone's dinner table to your chest
K11272.product_name: Vintage spoon pendant in nickel silver (GAW, white-heart beads × deerskin cord)
summary_points: One-of-a-kind pendant from GAW, Kobanzame's own remake line, made from an old spoon
Materials: nickel silver / glass beads (white hearts) / deerskin cord
Length: adjustable approx. 50–90 cm (pendant approx. 3 × 5 cm)
K11272.lead: We are Kobanzame, a vintage shop in an old wooden house in Kawagoe. Now and then a piece arrives that makes people look twice and ask, "What was this before?" This is one of them. Look closely: the pendant is a spoon.
K11272.body_html:
Its past life

The handle still carries an engraved floral pattern, probably from the decorative cutlery popular around the 1980s. It isn't from a famous maker, but the engraving suggests it once brightened someone's everyday table.

Its new life

We shaped the spoon into a pendant without erasing the engraving, and paired it with discontinued vintage white-heart beads and a treated deerskin cord. Slide the knot to wear it short at the collar or long down the chest. No two are alike. A one-of-a-kind piece from our GAW line.

Who it's for

Anyone who dislikes wearing the same mass-made accessory as everyone else, and wants one personal mark on a leather jacket or a plain T-shirt.

The next chapter is yours

Nickel silver and leather both deepen in colour with wear. It will look better the longer you live with it.
spec: Nickel silver / glass beads / deerskin cord
Pendant approx. 3 × 5 cm / length adjustable approx. 50–90 cm
Reused vintage spoon: some clouding and fine scratches from age
K11272.summary_text: One-of-a-kind GAW pendant made from an old spoon: nickel silver, vintage white-heart beads and deerskin cord, adjustable 50–90 cm.

K11274.title: A dinner-table spoon, now swinging from your belt
K11274.product_name: Vintage spoon brass wallet chain (GAW, approx. 49 cm)
summary_points: One-of-a-kind GAW wallet chain: a spoon from someone's table reworked into the hook
Materials: brass (curb chain and snap hook) / vintage spoon (silver tone)
Length: approx. 49 cm, a standard reach from belt loop to front pocket
K11274.lead: After the pendant, another spoon has been reborn. This time it hangs at the hip instead of the chest.
K11274.body_html:
Its past life

A single spoon from someone's dinner table. The engraving on the handle is still there; we kept it when reshaping the spoon into the hook.

Its new life

Paired with a brass curb chain and snap hook. The spoon's silver tone next to the antique gold of the brass gives it a depth a new chain doesn't have. Handmade by Kobanzame for the GAW line.

Fit

About 49 cm long: it reaches a wallet in the front pocket from the belt loop and hangs with a natural drape. Works with denim, slacks or wide trousers.

The next chapter is yours

The chain is new; the hook is the original spoon, so it shows fine scratches and dullness from age. Brass darkens beautifully with use.
spec: New handmade item. The hook is a reused vintage spoon with fine scratches and dullness
K11274.summary_text: One-of-a-kind GAW wallet chain: brass curb chain with a vintage spoon reworked into the hook, approx. 49 cm.

K10015.title: A T-shirt made for one night: St. Louis, 1994
K10015.product_name: 1994 Wild's Palace of Poison reunion T-shirt (Fruit of the Loom BEST, XXL, made in USA)
summary_points: Commemorative tee from the 1994 "Wild's Palace of Poison" Second Annual Reunion (St. Louis, USA)
Body: Fruit of the Loom BEST / 50% cotton, 50% polyester / made in U.S.A.
Size: XXL (shoulder 57.5 / chest 64 / length 76 / sleeve 22 cm), condition A
K10015.lead: Among vintage printed tees, you sometimes find one that was made for a single night. This is one of those.
K10015.body_html:
Its past life

From 1947 to 1964, St. Louis, Missouri had a drive-in called "Wild's Palace of Poison". In 1994 the car lovers who used to hang out there met again, and this shirt was made for that Second Annual Reunion.

The print

On the front: a skull and crossbones, a tombstone and the drive-in itself, with "Cruisin' Will Never Die!" and "Eat Here If It Kills You". The back is packed with logos of local garages and sponsors.

Body and size

Fruit of the Loom BEST, 50/50 cotton-polyester, made in U.S.A. A true oversized XXL. It has the natural feel of a 30-year-old shirt, with no noticeable damage.

Who it's for

Anyone who likes things a little sinister and very cool: classic American cars, rockabilly, hot rods.
spec: XXL / shoulder 57.5 cm, chest 64 cm, length 76 cm, sleeve 22 cm
The Way We Were - Wild's Palace of Poison Second Annual Reunion 1994 (St. Louis, MO)
A: good condition, no noticeable scratches or damage
K10015.summary_text: 1994 reunion T-shirt from the St. Louis drive-in Wild's Palace of Poison. Fruit of the Loom BEST, made in USA, XXL.

K10888.title: A jacket that has never walked a street, basting still in
K10888.product_name: 90s Cacharel 100% linen tailored jacket (mustard yellow, 3 buttons)
summary_points: 90s Cacharel (French brand), 100% linen, three-button tailored jacket
Colour: mustard yellow / basting stitches still in, close to unworn (condition A)
Size: shoulder 47 / chest 55.5 / length 81 / sleeve 64 cm
K10888.lead: Some vintage clothes have never been worn. This one still has its basting stitches in the pockets and hem.
K10888.body_html:
Its past life

Cacharel is a French brand known for florals and light, easy clothes. This is a jacket from the 1990s that has been waiting, basting still in, to be worn for the first time.

Colour and fabric

The shell is 100% linen. Mustard looks difficult but turns any outfit into a picture over jeans and a white T-shirt. The creases of linen are part of its character. Lining: viscose and acetate.

Who it's for

People who like a jacket that isn't too neat, and wear it as an extension of a T-shirt rather than as formalwear.
spec: Shoulder 47 cm, chest 55.5 cm, length 81 cm, sleeve 64 cm
A: good condition, no noticeable damage. Basting stitches remain
K10888.summary_text: 90s Cacharel 100% linen tailored jacket in mustard yellow, three buttons, basting stitches still in.

K10889.title: Price tag still on, waiting for decades
K10889.product_name: 70s–80s Bon Vivant linen-blend tailored jacket (deadstock, JCPenney tag attached)
summary_points: 70s–80s American deadstock, with the original JCPenney price tag ($79.99) and basting stitches
Materials: 53% viscose / 25% polyester / 12% linen / 10% silk (natural beige)
Size: shoulder 45 / chest 52 / length 70 / sleeve 65 cm (measured)
K10889.lead: Running a vintage shop, you sometimes meet clothes that only time has touched. Nobody has worn this one, for decades.
K10889.body_html:
Its past life

America, the 1970s–80s. The JCPenney price tag ($79.99) and basting stitches are still in place. It never left the store for anyone's home.

Its new life

You will be the first to wear it. Linen mixed with silk and viscose gives an unusual texture, with the relaxed silhouette of its time. Unused and in good condition.

Who it's for

Anyone looking for a jacket that works on its own from late summer into autumn, and who wants period tailoring in new condition.

New, unused (deadstock). JCPenney tag ($79.99) and basting stitches remain

K10715.title: A trench coat that is really serious rainwear
K10715.product_name: 80s MISTY WEATHER nylon long trench coat (black, length 105 cm)
summary_points: 80s MISTY WEATHER long trench in jet-black nylon (length 105 cm)
Light, crease-resistant, rain-resistant; partly rubber-coated lining
Size: marked 6 / chest 56, length 105, sleeve (from underarm) 42 cm, raglan sleeves / condition B
K10715.lead: When the rainy season comes, we think of this black coat. A trench on the outside, rainwear on the inside.
K10715.body_html:
Its past life

MISTY WEATHER, 1980s. A 105 cm long trench in jet-black nylon. Part of the lining is rubber-coated, so it is really rainwear shaped like a trench.

Details

Light, crease-resistant and good in the rain. The cape-like yoke over the shoulders and the stitching around the pockets give shadow and depth to an all-black coat. Raglan sleeves follow the shoulder, so shoulder width doesn't matter.

How to wear it

Open on dry days; belt tied loosely in the rain. Slight signs of wear, but the nylon still has its sheen. Professionally cleaned.
spec: Marked 6 / chest 56 cm, length 105 cm, sleeve (from underarm) 42 cm (raglan sleeves, shoulder not measurable)
B: slight signs of wear, no noticeable damage or stains. Cleaned
K10715.summary_text: 80s MISTY WEATHER long trench coat in jet-black nylon, 105 cm, raglan sleeves, partly rubber-coated lining.
